name: Scotland
dossier:
The Scotland national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Tartan Army, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 42 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The Tartan Army marches to North America, bringing immense passion, noise, and key Premier League stars.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Scotland will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group C and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group C. The connection between Andrew Robertson and John McGinn is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Andrew Robertson - the clinical defender who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Scotland are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Scotland have qualified for their first World Cup since France 1998, ending a 28-year wait.
Scotland boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (multiple).
